description: This file contains unit test cases for the RemotePortTunnel component in the OpenClaw project, specifically testing platform-specific behaviors on Darwin (macOS/iOS). It includes socket operations and error handling tests.

methods.name: drain stderr does not crash when handle closed
methods.description: Tests that draining stderr does not cause a crash when the handle is closed.
